float fM1
ref rF1
Begin Function { }
let fM1 := GetModIndex "FalloutNV.esm"
let rF1 := BuildRef fM1 1064545
rF1.Activate player
SetFunctionValue 1
End

steps.until:
float fM1
ref rF1
ref rP
ref rD
float fV
Begin Function { }
let fM1 := GetModIndex "FalloutNV.esm"
let rF1 := BuildRef fM1 1064545
let rP := player.GetParentCell
let rD := rF1.GetParentCell
if rP == rD
  let fV := 0
else
  let fV := 1
endif
SetFunctionValue fV
End

steps.query:
float fX
float fY
float fZ
float fT
float fSw
float fP
Begin Function { }
let fX := player.GetPos X
let fY := player.GetPos Y
let fZ := player.GetPos Z
let fT := (GetCurrentTime - %{t0}) * 120000
let fSw := player.IsSwimming
let fP := player.GetAngle X
SetFunctionValue (($ fX) + " " + ($ fY) + " " + ($ fZ) + " " + ($ fT) + " " + ($ fSw) + " " + ($ fP))
End
